---
title: "Invitation offered among selected patients"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Among patients selected for invitation, invitation-offered status is modeled
with a Bayesian age/sex-adjusted logistic regression. The reported probability
is standardized over the observed complete covariate rows; patients with
missing outcome or covariates remain excluded from that model denominator and
are counted explicitly.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "implementation_invitation_offered"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "04-implementation"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "invitation-offered-summary.parquet")
draws_path <- file.path(result_dir, "invitation-offered-draws.parquet")
model_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("analysis", "04-implementation", "models"))
model_path <- file.path(model_dir, "invitation-offered.rds")
cohort_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                         "analysis-cohort.parquet")
recruitment_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                              "analysis-recruitment.parquet")
if (!file.exists(cohort_path) || !file.exists(recruitment_path)) {
  stop("Invitation-offered analysis requires the built cohort and recruitment domain.")
}
input_paths <- c(cohort_path, recruitment_path)
input_paths <- input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)]
output_paths <- c(summary_path, draws_path, model_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "01-invitation-offered.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  offered_summary <- read_result_table(summary_path)
} else {
  recruitment_raw <- read_result_table(recruitment_path)
  offered_col <- intersect(c("invitation_offered", "offered_invitation",
                             "invitation_offer", "offered"),
                           names(recruitment_raw))[1L]
  if (is.na(offered_col)) {
    stop("Invitation-offered field is unavailable; expected `invitation_offered`.")
  }
  require_public_columns(recruitment_raw, c("id", offered_col),
                         "invitation-offered process outcome")
  indicator <- validate_binary(recruitment_raw[[offered_col]], offered_col)
  id_values <- as.character(recruitment_raw$id)
  if (anyNA(id_values) || any(!nzchar(id_values))) {
    stop("Invitation-offered process outcome has a missing pseudonymized id.")
  }
  id_groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(recruitment_raw)), id_values, drop = TRUE)
  process_rows <- lapply(id_groups, function(index) {
    values <- indicator[index]
    data.frame(
      id = id_values[index[[1L]]],
      offered = if (all(is.na(values))) NA_real_ else
        as.numeric(any(values == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  process <- do.call(rbind, process_rows)
  names(process)[names(process) == "offered"] <- offered_col
  rownames(process) <- NULL
  cohort <- read_result_table(cohort_path)
  require_public_columns(cohort, c("id", "tx", "age", "gender"),
                         "invitation-offered covariates")
  process <- merge(cohort[, c("id", "tx", "age", "gender"), drop = FALSE],
                   process[, c("id", offered_col), drop = FALSE],
                   by = "id", all = FALSE)
  process$age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(process$age)))
  process$gender <- as.factor(process$gender)
  process <- process[process$tx == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  model_data <- process[stats::complete.cases(
    process[, c(offered_col, "age", "gender"), drop = FALSE]
  ), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(model_data) == 0L) stop("No complete selected-patient rows support the offered model.")
  if (!requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'brms' is required for the invitation-offered model.")
  }
  model_formula <- stats::reformulate(c("age", "gender"), response = offered_col)
  fit <- brms::brm(
    model_formula,
    data = model_data,
    family = brms::bernoulli(link = "logit"),
    iter = 2000,
    chains = 4,
    cores = 1,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting"),
    refresh = 0,
    file = model_path
  )
  epred <- brms::posterior_epred(fit, newdata = model_data, re_formula = NA)
  standardized_draws <- data.frame(
    draw = rowMeans(epred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  offered_summary <- data.frame(
    outcome = "standardized_invitation_offered_probability",
    posterior_mean = mean(standardized_draws$draw),
    posterior_median = stats::median(standardized_draws$draw),
    lower_95 = stats::quantile(standardized_draws$draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = stats::quantile(standardized_draws$draw, 0.975),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write_module_draws(standardized_draws, draws_path)
  offered_summary$n_model <- nrow(model_data)
  offered_summary$n_selected <- nrow(process)
  write_module_table(offered_summary, summary_path)
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "fit"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "01-invitation-offered.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: offered-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior standardized probability of invitation being offered"

offered_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
